source_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality
continuity_scope: 忘语 (Wàng Yǔ), 《凡人修仙传》 (Fánrén Xiūxiān Zhuàn), original Chinese Qidian serialization: exact primary-text segment Chapter 57, 〈身醒敌亡〉, dated 27 April 2008 on Qidian. This is not a claim to cover the full serial. Donghua, manhua, games, live action, sequel/Immortal Realm material, unofficial translations, and all adaptation continuity are excluded.

work_or_witnesses.edition: WebNovel platform record under Wang Yu; English platform metadata/summary only, not used to replace the Chinese chapter or establish translation wording.

coverage_rule: This deliberately narrow primary-text segment includes only the individually named character 韩立/Hán Lì, explicitly present in the official Chapter 57 record. No other named dramatic person is added because the accessible official chapter extract and platform metadata do not support reliable same-segment identification/relationship verification without importing an unofficial translation, adaptation, or broader serial knowledge.
omissions: Every character other than 韩立 in the full serial, including any later/earlier chapter figure not directly verified in Chapter 57.
All later serialized arcs, sequel material, donghua, manhua, games, adaptations, unofficial translations, fandom reference claims, and commentary.
Cultivation stages, sects, techniques, artifacts, spirit roots, places, cosmology, and generic narrative functions as character nodes.
uncertainties: The scope is one Chinese serial chapter, not a novel-wide or franchise-complete pass. Its clean validation means only that this stated Chapter 57 audit is complete.
Chinese script, pinyin, and English titles/translations vary by platform. The Chinese chapter controls canonical wording; WebNovel provides platform orientation only.

Cultivation vocabulary (修仙, 灵根, 境界, 符, sect and artifact terms) is source-/genre-specific. It is not treated as a universal account of Chinese religion, Daoism, Buddhism, or real cultivation practice.
The wider serial contains combat, injury, death, coercion, and pursuit. This chapter-level record avoids unsupported plot expansion and graphic description.
evidence_basis: Qidian's official Chapter 57 page is the sole story-canon evidence. It visibly identifies the title, author, date, chapter number/title, and Han Li/韩立 in the chapter text, including the term 定神符. WebNovel is cited solely as publisher/platform metadata that its English listing concerns a commoner named Han Li; it is not a claim that an unofficial rendering is canonical.

supports: Exact Chinese primary segment, author/title/serial context, 韩立, and 定神符.
English platform title and summary identifying Han Li as a commoner seeking a foothold in his sect; orientation only.
